body:
Emojis need to have two instead of one space after them to avoid rendering bugs:
```suggestion
            symbol: "🦕  ",
```
This calls `.trim()`, but later in the test you don't call `.trim()` before passing to `parse_deno_version`, is it needed?

I'd prefer this (no `unwrap`, `split('\n')` -> `lines()`):
```suggestion
        // split into ["deno 1.8.3", ""]
        .lines()
        // get first line
        .next()?
```

But it even works without these lines for me:
```suggestion
```

+## Deno
+
+The `deno` module shows you your currently installed version of Deno.
+By default the module will be shown if any of the following conditions are met:
+- The current directory contains a `mod.ts`, `mod.js`, `deps.ts` or `deps.js` file
+
+### Options
+
+| Option              | Default                                           | Description                                     |
+| ------------------- | ------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------- |
+| `format`            | `"via [$symbol($version )]($style)"`              | The format for the module.                      |
+| `symbol`            | `"🦕 "`                                           | A format string representing the symbol of Dart |
